sampleTitle: The answer comes from the charter, not from the model
sampleBody: The model only writes the query. Every fact on an answer card is a row read from the charter graph.
sampleNote: Sample layout. Amounts, times and lists are left out here on purpose.
slaTitle: A second agent watches the clock
slaBody: It compares each step with the time the charter allows. Waiting at an outside agency is not counted as a delay by the office.

sla.external: At an outside agency, not counted

slaAlert: Drafting an alert for staff review
localTitle: Runs on the office's own computer
localBody: No cloud service is used while it runs. It only reads the charter data and never changes it.
